Name: The Balladeer Scaramouche (Project Genshin Farmer Preset) - Fashion Sense (FS)
Author: Arknir27
Description:
[size=3][i][size=3]"Scaramouche!
Scaramouche!
Will you do the Fandago?"  -- Queen[/size][/i]

Play as the Wanderer from Genshin Impact. Commissioned by -Xanthos- as part of my Project Genshin Overhaul. Requires PeacefulEnd's framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. Special thanks to PeacefulEnd.
[/size]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/994361829675507732/Fashion_Sense.png[/img]


[size=3]Dress up in the [i]totally [/i]unique Balladeer attire using the Hand Mirror.
Also includes hairstyle, hat, animated accessory, robes, shorts, and sandals. 
Hairstyle has a static version, as well as an editable color version.
[/size][size=3]Skin setting and Eye color in the image below:[/size]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/1099720757296234506/Eyes_and_Skin.jpg[/img]
﻿

[size=4]Hand Mirror Tutorial: ([s]Totally not for the Wanderer[/s]) ;)[/size]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/1099721282108530868/Equipping_Tutorial.gif[/img]
﻿
[i]* Feet may become censored when attempting to sit from the side, especially when facing left.[/i]

[b]Basically just the same as the wanderer, but for the Fatui version. I got lazy.[/b]
[size=3]Hairstyle: Balladeer's Hair (Static) and Editable version.
﻿Shirts: Balladeer Robe
Pants: Balladeer Shorts
Shoes: Balladeer Sandals
Hats: Balladeer's Hat
Accessories: Balladeer 'E'
[/size]
